phase-halfcycle-v1.pairing: ordinal observed/model extrema; truncate min count
phase-halfcycle-v1.speed_strata: valid observed abs(omega), numpy linear quantiles [1/3,2/3]; high >= second quantile
phase-halfcycle-v1.halfcycle_speed_strata: max(abs observed SG9 omega) within each paired observed halfcycle; linear quantiles [1/3,2/3] of interval maxima; low <=first, else high>=second, else middle; not frame-speed quantiles
phase-halfcycle-v1.halfcycle_contraction: signed E_peak[i]-E_peak[i+1], not absolute difference; compare model-observed, report MAE/RMSE
phase-halfcycle-v1.peak_frequency: observed uses M1 q; each prediction uses its own fitted q

tail-period-legacy-v1.crossing: adjacent source frames, positive dt, <=0 to >0 or >=0 to <0; linear interpolation
tail-period-legacy-v1.period: crossings[i+2]-crossings[i]; historical no segment/direction pair validation

energy-envelope-v1.historical_mask: compress valid theta/times for extrema; retain time values
energy-envelope-v1.skip_condition: skip only when n_peaks>2*skip; historical short-data behavior retained only in legacy
energy-envelope-v1.envelope: pure exp if last_amplitude/first_amplitude<0.05 else offset exp

curve_fit.RuntimeError: fall back to p0; historical only
curve_fit.provenance: scipy-curve-fit and scipy-lsq v1.17.1; diagnostic historical environment not fully locked

energy-envelope-v1.predicted_loss: Simpson integral of a1*omega^2+a2*abs(omega)^3; omega from CubicSpline state
energy-envelope-v1.R2: 1-SSE/max(SST,1e-30); at least3 finite pairs else unavailable
energy-envelope-v1.initial_theta_source: radians(formal fit row theta0_deg_signed); omega0 from row

identifiability-valley-v1.lambda_domain: lambda>0 plus declared raw bounds; raw nonnegative alpha_a means lambda>=1/s
identifiability-valley-v1.reference: illustrative raw set, not measured alpha_a
identifiability-valley-v1.vary: q only; hold fitted a1*,a2*,IC,samples,weights fixed
identifiability-valley-v1.curve: 222 archived q values incl exact fitted q; interpolate one-dimensional curve
identifiability-valley-v1.meaning: conditional surface, not profile likelihood, confidence interval or optimiser failure
identifiability-valley-v1.interpolation: numpy.interp linear in q on objective_over_fitted; no refitting
identifiability-valley-v1.initial_theta_source: radians(formal fit table theta0_deg_signed), not reloaded TOML; diagnostic-specific legacy round trip
